biggest_catch: The friend must BOOK (close) the loan with Har-co - a completed application alone earns nothing - and this is a 'limited time offer' that can be withdrawn without notice.
catches: Tiered gift cards: $100 for a referred HELOC, $50 for an auto loan, $25 for a Visa loan - paid once the referred loan is active.
Referrer must be a Har-co member; Har-co verifies the signature on the referral form against signatures on record.
Member eligibility requirements apply; Har-co will not tell the referrer the status of the friend's loan.
Gift card may be subject to IRS tax reporting.
'Limited time offer' - no end date stated; can be withdrawn at any time.
